message: Confirmed: a 5-hour technical contest for 120 students in teams of 4. Total budget Rs 900,000. 8 staff on duty. Please keep a 20-minute prayer break. Event starts at 09:00. The venue must have backup power. At least 25% of meals must be vegetarian.
Seminar 1 holds 100 people at Rs 60,000. Auditorium X holds 160 people at Rs 150,000 and has a generator. Main Arena holds 400 people at Rs 300,000 and has a generator.
Basic box Rs 650 per head, standard box Rs 900 per head, premium box Rs 1,500 per head. 5% tax applies to all food.
12 judges confirmed, Rs 8,000 each. 20 minutes per team, maximum 5 teams per judge.
Already paid: trophies Rs 60,000 and printing Rs 12,000.
Can someone share the parking map?
